projectDescription: A Suika-style physics merge game built with Python and pygame-ce, featuring a 17-element fusion chain, 480 FPS physics engine, and multiple game modes.
keyFeatures: 17-element fusion chain from 西西 to 钇钾
JaneFlyThought2 rotational physics with collision torque
Dynamic drop system unlocking higher-tier balls as you merge (Full mode)
Six game modes: Lite, Full, Debug, Full Debug, Demo, Q Self
AI autoplay with SmartBot / DumbBot / DemoBot
Q Self mode with custom ball images and names
NSIS installer for Windows + AppImage / .deb for Linux
Real-time parameter debug panel (Full Debug mode)
Save/restore game state with AppData persistence
Per-element sound effects and background music system
Spatial hash grid for O(1) collision detection
publicApiSurface: Keyboard shortcuts: B (Lite), A (Full), C (Debug), D (Demo), Q (Q Self), R (Restart), F11 (Fullscreen), ESC (Exit)
q_custom.json for Q Self mode customization
assets/images/ folder for custom ball PNG images
Save data: %APPDATA%\Trash Panda Q Opal\Big Alloy Merge\
elements.txt and Messages.txt for element names and merge messages
